rows.en:
Wait, huh? \p-kun?
What are you doing here?
rows.notes: Ranka, male. She is working at Nyan-Nyan.

rows.en:
What am I doing here...?
I came to eat, obviously.

R-right, of course!
Geez, what a weird thing for me to ask.

Okay, let me start over.
What would you like to order?
rows.notes: Ranka, both genders, switching to waitress politeness.

rows.en: Then, two maguro buns, please.

Certainly!
Just wait a little, okay?

(Seriously, just having Ranka here
makes the whole place feel brighter.)

(I bet there are customers who come here
just to see Ranka...)
Here you go, maguro buns.

You've been staring at me this whole time...
Is there something you need?
Well then, enjoy your meal~
(Maybe I stared a bit too much...)

Wait, huh? \p-chan?
What are you doing here?

(Seriously, just having Ranka-chan here
makes the whole place feel brighter.)

(I bet there are customers who come here
just to see Ranka-chan...)
(Okay, time to eat!)

(Oh, that's right, Sheryl's new single
came out last week.)
rows.notes: PLAYER, both genders. shinkyoku = new song; 'single' since it is bought.

rows.en:
(Huh? Isn't that Ranka over there,
looking all happy?)

Hey, Ranka!
What's got you looking so happy?

Well, I got paid for my part-time job,
so I could finally buy Sheryl's new single!

I'm just itching to rush home
and really listen to it...!
So you're a Sheryl fan, Ranka.

A fan? That doesn't even cover it!
I'm a huge, huge, HUGE fan!!
Ha ha, I see.

Anyway, I want to hurry home and listen,
so I'll get going.
Get home safe.
(Wow~ Ranka's a Sheryl fan through and through.)

(Huh? Isn't that Ranka-chan over there,
looking all happy?)

Hey, Ranka-chan!
What's got you looking so happy?
Oh, \p-chan.
So you're a Sheryl fan, Ranka-chan.

(Wow~ Ranka-chan's a Sheryl fan
through and through.)

(I stayed at school studying for a bit,
and now I'm heading home late.)

Ranka! What are you doing out
walking around at this hour?

I was chatting with Nana-chan after my shift,
and before I knew it, it got this late...
Isn't Ozma-san strict about curfew and stuff?
rows.notes: PLAYER, both genders. Ozma-san as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
Yeah. I just called to say I'd be late, and now
he keeps going on about coming to pick me up
at Nyan-Nyan. Even though home's not that far...

That just shows how worried he is
about you, Ranka.

Yeah, I know that.
I'll get going so he won't worry any more.
Okay, be careful.

You too, \p-kun.
See you.
(Seriously, what a close brother and sister.)

(I stayed at school studying for a bit,
and now I'm heading home late.)
Huh? \p-chan?

Ranka-chan! What are you doing out
walking around at this hour?

That just shows how worried he is
about you, Ranka-chan.
Okay, be careful.

You too, \p-chan.
See you.
(Seriously, what a close brother and sister.)

That's Ranka over there, right...?
Oh, they're shooting a commercial!
You look like you're doing great, Ranka.
Yep, I'm doing great.

So, um, the thing is, we're filming right now,
so I'd kind of like you to keep it down
just a little...

Oh, right... Sorry, sorry...
I got a little too excited...

No, I'm the one who's sorry.
You were cheering me on and everything.
Oh, they're calling me, so I've gotta go!
Okay, go get 'em.
(Ranka's totally become the girl of the moment.)

That's Ranka-chan over there, right...?
Oh, they're shooting a commercial!
Yoo-hoo! Ranka-chaaan! Go for it!!
Oh, looks like she noticed!
rows.notes: Female; same English as male c17970.

rows.en: You look like you're doing great, Ranka-chan.

Oh, right... Sorry, sorry...
I got a little too excited... Tee-hee...
Okay, good luck!

(Ranka-chan's totally become
the girl of the moment.)
